text:
alex: Quick note 1: we've been given a corner kiosk in Community Alley (6ft table, small monitor). There's a 3-slot micro-stage nearby (5min each) at 17:30. Goals: demo Redwood Optimize live, capture webinar signups, hand out a short benchmark one-pager, and collect qualified leads. Need owners for: speaker intake, QR + funnel, swag order, and pickup plan. Budget: ~$750 recommended.

priya: I can run speaker intake + curate the 5-min demos. I'll make a Google Form for submissions (name, title, short blurb, preferred slot). Will share by EOD. Also want a short speaker cheat sheet with 3 points to hit: 1) cost/latency tradeoff, 2) a quick before/after demo, 3) CTA to signup.

ben: I'll do the QR funnel -> CRM mapping. Idea: QR => /signup?src=comm-alley -> form (email, company, use-case, interest flags) -> tag 'comm-alley' and 'micros-demo'. Then webhook into HubSpot with property 'event_interest:dedicated|hosted|private'. Auto-email: immediate thank-you w/ webinar invite + link to benchmark PDF. Also add a webhook that pings #sales for 'dedicated' flags.

taylor: Swag options within $750: 300 sticker packs + 150 pocket guides (2-sided fold card with QR + micro-bench). If we stretch to $1.5k we can add a branded micro-notebook. For low-cost novelty: consider a mystery scratch-card that gives a 1-month API credit (small % winners). Thoughts?

lucy: Logistics: EZShip and DropShipPro can pre-deliver to venue; hotel storage windows usually 24-72h depending on venue. Recommend pickup day-of by an on-site courier. If we do scratch-cards, need to check redemption flow with billing.

sam: Fun interactive hook: "Tell us your expected monthly tokens and we'll show an estimated monthly inference bill using Redwood Optimize profiles." QR leads to a 1-field estimator + CTA to book a follow-up. Short prototype can live as a Serverless function; I'll sketch the endpoint: ```POST /estimate {"tokens":123456} -> {"monthly_est": "$X"}```. Will wire to thank-you mail.

legal-bot: Reminder: any use of the word 'benchmark' needs a methodology blurb. Please include a 2-line methodology and a link to the full doc. Also, if you plan a prize draw (scratch-cards), we need rules and opt-in consent for marketing.

alex: Great. Action items recap: Priya -> form + speaker cheat sheet by EOD. Ben -> QR funnel mapping + HubSpot webhook by Tue. Taylor -> merch SKU list + vendor quote by Wed. Lucy -> confirm courier & venue storage by Wed. Sam -> prototype estimator endpoint by Tue. Legal-bot -> methodology blurb and prize rules by Mon.

priya: Staffing: need 2 people at the kiosk 17:15-18:15 (pre-stage rush) and 18:45-19:30. Who can staff? Happy to take the early shift.

sam: I can do 17:15-18:15 and man the estimator demos.

taylor: I'll do 18:45-19:30 and handle swag. If prizes are involved I can manage redemption.

lucy: Vendor reco: DropShipPro turnaround is fast; they quoted $95 for same-city pickup + $45 handling. If we use EZShip it's cheaper but slower. Will confirm dimensions & weight once Taylor posts final SKU list.

ben: Lead routing quick notes: Tag mapping -> {"dedicated":"sales-assist-dedicated","hosted":"marketing-nurture"}. Also add an 'event:community-alley' property. For high-intent leads (selected demo + asks for POC) auto-create task for AE.

priya: Speaker deadline: Fri 23:59. I'll close signups then and send last-minute coaching tips.

alex: Two small asks before close: 1) Make the pocket fold-card include a tiny methodology blur (legal approved) and QR on the back for the benchmark PDF. 2) Keep the signup form minimal (email + company + 1 checkbox for follow-up). Low friction.

sam: Agreed. Also propose we add a tiny UTM param to the QR so we can track traffic source in analytics: `?utm_source=comm-alley&utm_medium=qr`.

legal-bot: Draft methodology blurb posted in #legal: "Benchmarks run using OpenModel-x v1.2 with 512 context, synthetic dialogue prompts, average latency measured across 1000 runs on NVIDIA-A100; cost estimates based on standard token pricing and Redwood Optimize configuration 3." Please confirm placement on card.

alex: Perfect. Final logistics: courier pickup window Fri afternoon, on-site stash in booth contractor room, staff list to events-bot for badges. I'll make the runbook and post in #marketing before tomorrow morning. :rocket:
